mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.key, t.label, t.color, t.shape, t.builtin, t.description, ARRAY(SELECT p.parent_id FROM entity_type_parents p WHERE p.child_id = t.id) AS parents, (SELECT p.parent_id FROM entity_type_parents p WHERE p.child_id = t.id AND p.is_primary) AS primary_parent, ARRAY(SELECT d.b_id FROM entity_type_disjoint d WHERE d.kb_id = t.kb_id AND d.a_id = t.id) AS disjoint, COALESCE(u.usage, 0) AS usage FROM entity_types t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT type_id, count(*)::bigint AS usage FROM entities WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND merged_into IS NULL AND type_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY type_id ) u ON u.type_id = t.id WHERE t.kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY lower(t.label)

SELECT r.id, r.key, r.label, r.temporal, r.functional, r.inverse_functional, r.is_transitive, r.is_symmetric, r.is_asymmetric, r.is_irreflexive, r.inverse_of, r.sub_property_of, r.builtin, r.description, r.kind, r.datatype, r.unit, ARRAY(SELECT d.entity_type_id FROM relation_type_domains d WHERE d.relation_type_id = r.id) AS domains, ARRAY(SELECT g.entity_type_id FROM relation_type_ranges g WHERE g.relation_type_id = r.id) AS ranges, ARRAY(SELECT q.qualifier_type_id FROM relation_type_qualifiers q WHERE q.relation_type_id = r.id) AS qualifiers, COALESCE(u.usage, 0) AS usage FROM relation_types r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT predicate_id, count(*)::bigint AS usage FROM facts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND predicate_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY predicate_id ) u ON u.predicate_id = r.id WHERE r.kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY lower(r.label)

SELECT e.id, e.canonical_name AS name, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = e.kb_id AND (f.subject_id = e.id OR f.object_id = e.id) AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL) AS fact_count FROM entities e WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.type_id = #{typeId} AND e.merged_into IS NULL ORDER BY lower(e.canonical_name), e.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM entities e WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.type_id = #{typeId} AND e.merged_into IS NULL
SELECT kind, key, example, count FROM ontology_misses WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND dismissed_at IS NULL ORDER BY count DESC, key
SELECT kind, key, example, count FROM ontology_misses WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND dismissed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY count DESC, key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relation_types (id, kb_id, key, label, temporal, functional, inverse_functional, description, kind, datatype, unit, is_transitive, is_symmetric, is_asymmetric, is_irreflexive, inverse_of, sub_property_of) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{key}, #{label}, #{temporal}, #{functional}, #{inverseFunctional}, #{description}, #{kind}, #{datatype}, #{unit}, #{transitive}, #{symmetric}, #{asymmetric}, #{irreflexive}, #{inverseOf}, #{subPropertyOf})

INSERT INTO relation_type_domains (relation_type_id, entity_type_id) SELECT #{id}, x FROM unnest(#{typeIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AS x ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO relation_type_ranges (relation_type_id, entity_type_id) SELECT #{id}, x FROM unnest(#{typeIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AS x ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT kind FROM relation_types WHERE id = #{id} AND kb_id = #{kbId}
SELECT builtin AND key = 'known_as' FROM relation_types WHERE id = #{id} AND kb_id = #{kbId}
mapper.update: UPDATE relation_types SET label = #{label}, temporal = #{temporal}, functional = #{functional}, inverse_functional = #{inverseFunctional}, description = #{description}, datatype = CASE WHEN kind = 'attribute' AND #{datatype}::text IS NOT NULL THEN #{datatype}::text ELSE datatype END, unit = CASE WHEN kind = 'attribute' THEN #{unit}::text ELSE unit END, is_transitive = #{transitive}, is_symmetric = #{symmetric}, is_asymmetric = #{asymmetric}, is_irreflexive = #{irreflexive}, inverse_of = #{inverseOf}, sub_property_of = #{subPropertyOf}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND kb_id = #{kbId}
mapper.select: SELECT entity_type_id FROM relation_type_domains WHERE relation_type_id = #{id}
SELECT entity_type_id FROM relation_type_ranges WHERE relation_type_id = #{id}
SELECT count(*) FROM relation_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND kind = 'attribute' AND id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})
SELECT count(*) FROM relation_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND kind = 'attribute' AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relation_type_qualifiers (relation_type_id, qualifier_type_id) SELECT #{id}, x FROM unnest(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AS x ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO relation_type_qualifiers (relation_type_id, qualifier_type_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{qualifierTypeId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO entity_types (id, kb_id, key, label, color, shape, description) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{key}, #{label}, #{color}, #{shape}, #{description})
INSERT INTO entity_type_parents (child_id, parent_id, is_primary) VALUES (#{childId}, #{parentId}, #{primary}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT parent_id FROM entity_type_parents WHERE child_id = #{childId}
SELECT count(*) FROM entities WHERE type_id = #{typeId}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM entity_type_parents WHERE parent_id = #{typeId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM relation_type_domains WHERE entity_type_id = #{typeId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM relation_type_ranges WHERE entity_type_id = #{typeId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM relation_types r WHERE r.kind = 'attribute' AND r.kb_id = #{kbId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_type_domains d WHERE d.relation_type_id = r.id AND d.entity_type_id = #{typeId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_type_domains d WHERE d.relation_type_id = r.id AND d.entity_type_id <> #{typeId})
DELETE FROM entity_types WHERE id = #{id} AND kb_id = #{kbId} AND NOT builtin
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE predicate_id = #{predicateId}
mapper.update: UPDATE relation_types SET inverse_of = NULL WHERE inverse_of = #{id}
UPDATE relation_types SET sub_property_of = NULL WHERE sub_property_of = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM relation_types WHERE id = #{id} AND kb_id = #{kbId} AND NOT builtin
mapper.select: INSERT INTO relation_types (id, kb_id, key, label, temporal, functional, inverse_functional, description, kind, datatype, iri, is_transitive, is_symmetric, is_asymmetric, is_irreflexive) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), #{kbId}, k, l, 'state', fu, iv, d, kind, dt, i, tr, sy, asym, irr FROM UNNEST(#{keys,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[], #{labels,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[], #{descs,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[], #{iris,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[], #{kinds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[], #{datatypes,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[], #{functional,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.BooleanArrayTypeHandler}::bool[], #{inverseFunctional,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.BooleanArrayTypeHandler}::bool[], #{transitive,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.BooleanArrayTypeHandler}::bool[], #{symmetric,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.BooleanArrayTypeHandler}::bool[], #{asymmetric,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.BooleanArrayTypeHandler}::bool[], #{irreflexive,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.BooleanArrayTypeHandler}::bool[]) AS t(k, l, d, i, kind, dt, fu, iv, tr, sy, asym, irr) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, key
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM entity_type_disjoint WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND (a_id = #{classId} OR b_id = #{classId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO entity_type_disjoint (kb_id, a_id, b_id) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{a}, #{b}), (#{kbId}, #{b}, #{a}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM relation_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND (#{onlyKind}::text IS NULL OR kind = #{onlyKind}) ORDER BY embedding <=> #{vector}::vector LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND (#{onlyKind}::text IS NULL OR kind = #{onlyKind}))

SELECT id, label, coalesce(description, '') AS description, embedding IS NOT NULL AS embedded, embedded_model, embedded_text, label_embedding IS NOT NULL AS label_embedded, label_embedded_model, label_embedded_text FROM entity_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}

SELECT id, label, coalesce(description, '') AS description, embedding IS NOT NULL AS embedded, embedded_model, embedded_text, false AS label_embedded, NULL::text AS label_embedded_model, NULL::text AS label_embedded_text FROM relation_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND NOT (builtin AND key = 'known_as')
mapper.update: UPDATE entity_types SET embedding = #{vector}::vector, embedded_text = #{text}, embedded_model = #{model} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE entity_types SET label_embedding = #{vector}::vector, label_embedded_text = #{text}, label_embedded_model = #{model} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE relation_types SET embedding = #{vector}::vector, embedded_text = #{text}, embedded_model = #{model} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE up(id) AS ( SELECT unnest(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) UNION SELECT p.parent_id FROM entity_type_parents p JOIN up ON p.child_id = up.id ) SELECT id FROM up WHERE id <> ALL(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[])
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM type_bindings WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status <> 'bound') AS kind_words, (SELECT count(*) FROM phrase_bindings WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status <> 'bound') AS phrases
SELECT section, key, payload, proposed_by, serves, signatures FROM ontology_proposals WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'open' ORDER BY created_at DESC, key

SELECT i.id, i.filename, i.format, i.byte_size, i.summary, i.imported_at, u.nick_name AS imported_by_name FROM ontology_imports i LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.utopia_uuid = i.imported_by WHERE i.kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY i.imported_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open') AS open, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'adopted') AS adopted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'adopted' AND edited) AS adopted_edited, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'rejected') AS rejected FROM ontology_proposals WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND proposed_by = 'agent'
SELECT id, key, iri FROM entity_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY key
SELECT id, key, iri FROM relation_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY key

INSERT INTO entity_types (id, kb_id, key, label, color, shape, description, iri) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), #{kbId}, k, l, c, s, d, i FROM UNNEST(#{keys,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[], #{labels,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[], #{descs,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[], #{iris,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[], #{colors,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[], #{shapes,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[]) AS t(k, l, d, i, c, s) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, key
UPDATE entity_types SET label = #{label}, description = CASE WHEN #{description} = '' THEN description ELSE #{description} END, updated_at = now() WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND iri = #{iri} RETURNING id
UPDATE entity_types SET iri = #{iri}, shape = 'square', updated_at = now() WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND key = #{key} AND iri IS NULL RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO entity_type_parents (child_id, parent_id) SELECT c, p FROM UNNEST(#{children,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[], #{parents,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AS x(c, p) WHERE c <> p ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO entity_type_disjoint (kb_id, a_id, b_id) SELECT #{kbId}, x, y FROM UNNEST(#{a,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[], #{b,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AS t(x, y) WHERE x <> y ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE relation_types SET label = #{label}, description = CASE WHEN #{description} = '' THEN description ELSE #{description} END WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND iri = #{iri} RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relation_type_domains (relation_type_id, entity_type_id) SELECT r, t FROM UNNEST(#{rels,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[], #{types,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AS x(r, t) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO relation_type_ranges (relation_type_id, entity_type_id) SELECT r, t FROM UNNEST(#{rels,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[], #{types,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AS x(r, t) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE relation_types r SET inverse_of = t.id FROM UNNEST(#{src,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[], #{dst,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[]) AS p(src, dst) JOIN relation_types t ON t.kb_id = #{kbId} AND t.iri = p.dst WHERE r.kb_id = #{kbId} AND r.iri = p.src AND r.id <> t.id

UPDATE relation_types r SET sub_property_of = t.id FROM UNNEST(#{src,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[], #{dst,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}::text[]) AS p(src, dst) JOIN relation_types t ON t.kb_id = #{kbId} AND t.iri = p.dst WHERE r.kb_id = #{kbId} AND r.iri = p.src AND r.id <> t.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ontology_imports (id, kb_id, sha256, filename, format, byte_size, summary, imported_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{sha256}, #{filename}, #{format}, #{byteSize}, #{summary}, #{actor})

INSERT INTO ontology_proposals (id, kb_id, section, key, payload, proposed_by, serves, signatures) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{section}, #{key}, #{payload}, 'agent', #{serves,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}, #{signatures}) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, section, key) DO UPDATE SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload, proposed_by = 'agent', serves = EXCLUDED.serves, signatures = EXCLUDED.signatures, created_at = now() WHERE ontology_proposals.status = 'open'
mapper.select: SELECT signatures FROM ontology_proposals WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND proposed_by = 'agent'
SELECT section, key, payload, proposed_by, serves, signatures FROM ontology_proposals WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND section = #{section} AND key = #{key} AND status = 'open'
mapper.update: UPDATE ontology_proposals SET status = #{status}, decided_by = #{actor}, decided_at = now() WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND section = #{section} AND key = #{key} AND status = 'open'
UPDATE ontology_proposals SET status = 'rejected', reason = #{reason}, decided_by = #{actor}, decided_at = now() WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND section = #{section} AND key = #{key} AND status = 'open'
UPDATE ontology_proposals SET edited = TRUE WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND section = #{section} AND key = #{key}
mapper.select: SELECT kind, shape, outcome, target, basis FROM ontology_agent_reviews WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ontology_agent_reviews (kb_id, kind, shape, outcome, target, basis) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{kind}, #{shape}, #{outcome}, #{target}, #{basis}) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, kind, shape) DO UPDATE SET outcome = EXCLUDED.outcome, target = EXCLUDED.target, basis = EXCLUDED.basis, reviewed_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT id, key, label, coalesce(description, '') AS description, NULL AS kind, (${column} <=> #{vector}::vector)::float8 AS distance FROM entity_types t WHERE t.kb_id = #{kbId} AND t.${column} IS NOT NULL AND (coalesce(btrim(t.description), '') <> '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_type_parents p WHERE p.child_id = t.id OR p.parent_id = t.id)) ORDER BY ${column} <=> #{vector}::vector LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, key, label, coalesce(description, '') AS description, kind, (embedding <=> #{vector}::vector)::float8 AS distance FROM relation_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND (#{onlyKind}::text IS NULL OR kind = #{onlyKind}) ORDER BY embedding <=> #{vector}::vector LIMIT #{limit}
